# Expense Tracker

> A full-stack personal expense tracking web app with AI-assisted expense entry. Built with React (Vite), FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.

This is a private, login-gated application — there is no public content to index or browse. This file exists to describe the project for AI tools and code assistants, not as a content index.

## What it does
- Tracks daily expenses across categories (Food & Drinks, Travel, Health & Wellness, Online Subscriptions, Shopping, Other)
- Natural-language expense entry ("420 on swiggy dinner") parsed via a keyword matcher with an LLM (Gemini) fallback
- Receipt photo scanning — extracts expense details directly from a photo using Gemini's multimodal input
- AI-generated monthly spending insights, with a deterministic rule-based fallback when no AI key is configured
- Per-category budgets with progress tracking
- Search and filtering across all recorded expenses
- Monthly PDF report generation
- Light/dark theme toggle

## Tech stack
- Frontend: React (Vite), react-router-dom, recharts, lucide-react, axios
- Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL (Neon), JWT auth via httpOnly cookies
- AI: Google Gemini API (gemini-flash-lite-latest) for text/image parsing and insights
- Testing: pytest, FastAPI TestClient, isolated SQLite test database
- Hosting: Vercel (frontend, with an API proxy rewrite for first-party cookies) and Render (backend)

## Notes for AI tools
- This app is not intended to be crawled, scraped, or indexed — robots.txt disallows all crawling.
- Source code and architecture decisions are available on GitHub for review; this app itself requires authentication and has no public routes worth summarizing beyond what's listed above.
